# Reports: Trigger an Inventory Summary Report

Area overview and notes: [reports.md](../reports.md)

`POST /reports/inventory-summary` · tenant-scoped token

Triggers an asynchronous inventory summary report containing per-account asset details such as quantities, cost basis, and average unit cost. Use the [GET /reports/inventory-summary/{reportId}](https://apidocs.taxbit.com/reference/get_reports-inventory-summary-reportId) endpoint to poll for status and download the report once complete.

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `as_of_timestamp` | string (date-time) | Yes | The point-in-time for which to generate the inventory summary. |
| `account_ids` | array of string | No | Optional list of your system's unique identifiers for the accounts to include in the report. If omitted, all accounts in the organization are included. |

Example request body:

```json
{"as_of_timestamp":"2026-01-15T00:00:00Z","account_ids":["account-1","account-2"]}
```

**Response 202**: Report Successfully Triggered

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.report_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The unique identifier for the inventory summary report. |
| `data.status` | string | Yes | The current status of the report. One of: `pending`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed`. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request - Invalid request body. Ensure as_of_timestamp is a valid ISO 8601 datetime and account_ids (if provided) does not exceed 10,000 items. · 401 Unauthorized · 429 Too Many Requests
